connectionSpecification.description: Reads TikTok advertisers, campaigns, ad groups, ads and daily BASIC reports from the TikTok Business API.

access_token.description: Long-lived access token of a TikTok Business API app, or a sandbox token. It is sent in the Access-Token header.
access_token.title: Access Token

advertiser_ids.description: Advertisers to read; each must be authorised for the access token.
advertiser_ids.title: Advertiser IDs

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose reports are read; empty reads up to today (UTC).
end_date.title: End Date

lookback_days.description: Days, 0 to 30, before the saved stat_time_day an incremental report read starts again, since TikTok still updates recent days.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose reports are read.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: TikTok Marketing Source Spec
